en.hubeali: H 14634 – Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Bakr Bin Saleh, from Ibn Sinan, from Amro Bin Shimr, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws said:
‘The wisdom is the objective of the believer, so wherever one of you finds his objective, so he should take it’.
en.sarwar: 186. Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Bakr Bin Saleh, from Ibn Sinan, from Amro Bin Shimr, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) said:
